title: CNC Cell Transfer Freeze-Window Recovery
goal: Repair a flexible job shop baseline for a CNC machining cell where operations released before a freeze horizon must keep locked fields, later operations must absorb maintenance outages, and the final schedule in /app/output/cnc_recovery_plan.json must remain within machine-change and start-shift budgets.
skillBenefitRationale: Transfers the same repair workflow into a release-freeze setting while preserving the core payoff of precedence anchoring, right-shift-only repair, downtime avoidance, and policy-budget compliance.
